title: Anything for You
overview: Olivia (Sydney Lovering), a quiet barista, finds herself drawn to Logan (Nathan Mucher), a dark and enigmatic man who offers her the freedom and excitement she's always desired. As their relationship grows, the tension with Olivia's controlling mother intensifies, with her disapproval threatening to tear them apart. Logan becomes overly protective, yet something about him remains mysterious. Olivia holds onto the promise of their future together, but the lingering sense that Logan is hiding something may soon challenge the very foundation of their love.
